# ibee_container_registries (Data Source)

The workspace's Container Registry registries, newest first, as the API lists them (every page).

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_docs.py; edit schema descriptions in Go. -->

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ibee_container_registries" "all" {}

output "registry_names" {
  value = [for r in data.ibee_container_registries.all.registries : r.name]
}
```
